fixed.member: Theme art: panel and plate faces
fixed.summary: A material's gloss band (plastic, flat) is drawn on buttons and chips only. Panels and plates carry text from their top edge, and a light ink could not hold on a dark face under the band (candy's pause objective read at 3.3:1).
A project's drawn theme art (`.og/ui-art/`) is drawn again when the engine draws it differently, instead of keeping art an older engine drew until the recipe changed.
